estimate: Use the existing reference cost per validated vertex. Estimate two validations per copy in each of the four refinement passes, with a 0.1 reference-second floor and a ceiling of 10% of the total budget. No job identities or benchmark-specific geometry enter the decision.
default: Ordinary nesting and the hole-reserving bonus retain their existing allocation. Repeat the same work-budget requests on the measured previous and candidate binaries to check those paths.

confirmation: Only a new, full matched 234-run matrix can close H5. Keep the first opt-in matrix and all further pilot outcomes separate. Preserve the default policy regardless of result.
